infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zimi Live uses your camera for video calls, live broadcasts, and profile photos when you choose to use these features.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Zimi Live uses your microphone when you start or join an audio or video call, or host a live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zimi Live lets you choose photos from your library for your profile.
